purpose: Fast per-turn bootstrap: confirm the cube is coherent, gather a timing sample, and avoid spending a turn on the wrong test slice.

immediate_process_policy.reason: A cloudtainer turn should not rely on watch servers, browsers, or daemons surviving into the next assistant turn.
immediate_process_policy.perTurnFirstMove: Run this bootstrap or list the desired test slice before editing deeply.
withinTurnReusableProcesses: local HTTP server for browser tests
single Chromium/CDP session for a selected browser slice
one-shot worker pool for timing probes
startImmediatelyOnlyWhen: the selected manifest slice needs a local browser/CDP page
the selected slice explicitly owns setup and teardown in the same command
forbiddenByDefault: background daemon waiting for a later turn
server or browser process without teardown
